product_overview: Wateen is an Arabic-first, location-aware on-demand nursing and telehealth platform for Egypt that connects patients with certified nurses, provides dynamic pricing and real-time dispatch, and extends into advanced features (wearables, AI copilot, blockchain wallet). The platform emphasizes geospatial matching, safety, and privacy while supporting low-connectivity environments.
core_goals: Enable fast, reliable home-nursing visit requests with robust visit lifecycle management
Provide transparent, auditable pricing estimates before booking
Match patients to nearest qualified nurses in real time using Redis + PostGIS support
Deliver real-time notifications and live tracking (WebSockets) for patient and nurse apps
Build privacy-first advanced capabilities for vitals streaming, mission logging, AI assistance, and patient-controlled health wallets

features.name: User Authentication & Profiles
features.description: Phone- and national-id-based authentication with custom user model, plus Patient and Nurse profiles created and managed per account.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill phone number field -> Fill password field -> Click Login button -> See dashboard
Navigate to /register -> Fill phone, national ID, and password -> Click Register -> See onboarding form -> Complete profile details -> See profile page
Navigate to /register -> Fill invalid national id -> Click Register -> See validation error 'Invalid National ID' shown

features.name: Create Visit Request (Patient Booking)
features.description: Patient selects a service, selects/adjusts a location on the map, optionally consents to wearables/blackbox, and submits a visit request which is persisted as a PENDING Visit.
user_flows: Open Patient App -> Open Services list -> Tap desired service card -> Open Location Picker -> Drop pin at correct entrance -> Tap Confirm Location -> Enter optional notes -> Tap Request Nurse -> See confirmation 'Request created' and status = PENDING
Open Patient App -> Select service -> Drop pin outside supported area -> Tap Request Nurse -> See error message 'No nurses available in your area' and suggestion to expand search or wait

features.name: Geospatial Matching & Dispatch
features.description: Matching engine finds nearby available nurses using Redis geo-index (hot path) with PostGIS as persistent backing; top-ranked nurses are notified via WebSocket for first-accept-wins dispatch.
user_flows: System receives new visit request -> Matching engine performs GEOSEARCH for nurses within 5km -> Filter results for availability and specialization -> Ranked top candidate list created -> Publish visit_request to nurse channels via Redis -> Nurse receives push notification

System receives new visit request -> Matching engine performs GEOSEARCH -> No candidates found -> Expand radius and retry up to configured rounds -> If still no match notify patient 'Delay - we are dispatching admin assistance'

features.name: Pricing Estimate (Public API)
features.description: Exposed estimate endpoint returns a price breakdown (base_price, distance_fee, night_fee, total) computed by the Pricing Engine factors (service base, per-km fee, night premium, multipliers).
user_flows: Navigate to POST /api/v1/visits/estimate/ -> Send JSON body with lat, lng, service_id -> Receive 200 response with price_breakdown.base_price -> See price_breakdown.total and itemized fields
Navigate to POST /api/v1/visits/estimate/ -> Send JSON missing service_id -> Receive 400 validation error 'service_id is required' and error details

features.name: Payments Webhook & Visit Lifecycle Completion (Mocked)
features.description: Payment webhook simulates gateway callbacks used in tests to transition visit state (e.g., to COMPLETED) and create financial transactions.
user_flows: Simulate payment provider -> POST /api/v1/payments/webhook/mock/ with visit_id and status 'paid' -> System validates payload -> Visit status transitions to COMPLETED -> System creates Transaction record -> Patient receives payment confirmation
POST /api/v1/payments/webhook/mock/ with invalid visit_id -> Webhook handler returns 404 -> Visit remains in prior state and error is logged

features.name: Real-time Notifications & WebSockets
features.description: ASGI + Django Channels infrastructure delivers low-latency push events to nurse and patient PWAs (visit requests, acceptances, ETA updates).
user_flows: Open Nurse App -> Establish WebSocket connection -> Authenticate over socket -> Subscribe to nurse_{nurse_id} channel -> Receive incoming visit event -> See request UI card
Open Nurse App -> Attempt to open WebSocket -> Connection fails -> App displays 'Disconnected' banner -> Incoming requests are not delivered and retry logic runs

features.name: Nurse Location Updates & Live Tracking
features.description: Nurse app sends periodic location updates (Redis geo hot-path) enabling patient-side live map tracking and ETA calculations.
user_flows: Open Nurse App -> Toggle 'Share location' -> App sends periodic location updates -> Matching service updates Redis geo index -> Patient map shows live nurse marker and ETA updates every few seconds
Open Nurse App -> Deny location permission -> App shows permission prompt and 'Location required to share ETA' -> Patient map shows 'Nurse location unavailable'

features.name: Wearables Vitals Streaming
features.description: Optional per-visit vitals consent and device pairing allow streaming vitals (heart rate, SpO2, temperature) to backend via secure channels for real-time monitoring and anomaly detection.
user_flows: Open Patient App -> On visit request consent to wearables -> Pair device (simulated) -> Start vitals stream -> Backend receives and stores vitals -> Assigned nurse sees live vitals on visit screen
Open Patient App -> Skip/deny vitals consent -> Attempt to start vitals stream -> System rejects stream and displays 'Consent required to transmit vitals'

features.name: AI Copilot for Nurses
features.description: Context-aware AI assistant helps nurses with dosage calculations, drug interactions and protocol lookups (queries anonymized and logged for auditing).
user_flows: Open Nurse App -> Open AI Copilot -> Enter text query 'dosage paracetamol for 70kg adult' -> Submit query -> Receive computed dosage with source references and confidence score
Open Nurse App -> Enter query containing patient-identifying data without consent -> Submit query -> System redacts PHI and prompts 'Please anonymize patient data' before proceeding

features.name: Blackbox Mission Logging (Consented Recording)
features.description: Client-side encrypted audio/video capture for high-risk visits with consent workflows and immutable audit references; blobs are uploaded encrypted and access is controlled/audited.
user_flows: At visit start nurse taps 'Start Recording' -> Prompt requests patient consent -> Patient taps Accept -> App begins encrypted recording -> Recording uploaded and stored with audit entry
At visit start nurse taps 'Start Recording' -> Patient taps Decline -> App blocks recording and shows 'Recording requires consent' message
